ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed towards low-intensity (black) pixels; ventral surface is approximately 98% dark with isolated high-intensity pixels localized at distal tips and small scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominantly uniform black across both lobes; small, localized white-pixel clusters (mottling) visible at the outer distal tips (coordinates roughly at the extreme left and right extremities) and sparse circular focal spots randomly distributed across the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central notch presents as a deep, narrow V-shape with an estimated angle of 22 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending significantly toward the fluke's insertion point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitude of peaks ranges from 3 to 15 pixels relative to the mean edge boundary; most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed, upward-tilted distal tips; symmetrical sweep across the horizontal axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular white pixel clusters localized heavily on the distal tips of both lobes and in smaller clusters along the lower margins, consistent with barnacle-related scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, oriented from the trailing edge toward the center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization at the outer tips of both lobes; several small, distinct circular scars visible on the right lobe's ventral surface.
